description: Locale configuration for Greek (el) in moment.js, defining months, weekdays, meridiem, date formats, calendar formats, relative time, and week settings.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Returns the month name in nominative or genitive form based on the format and date.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns 'πμ' or 'ΠΜ' for morning and 'μμ' or 'ΜΜ' for afternoon/evening based on hours.

methods.name: isPM
methods.description: Determines if the input time is in the PM.

methods.name: calendar
methods.description: Returns the calendar string for a given key and moment object, replacing '{}' with 'στη' or 'στις' based on the hour.

methods.name: lastWeek
methods.description: Returns the string for last week, with different output for Saturday and other days.
